simple.meaning: מַאֲרָב (maʼărâb) is a Hebrew word meaning “an ambuscade.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַאֲרָב (H3993) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 8:9, with occurrences in Joshua, Judges, 2 Chronicles, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַאֲרָב (H3993) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַאֲרָב (H3993) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַאֲרָב (maʼărâb) / H3993 is traced through Joshua 8:9, Judges 9:35, 2 Chronicles 13:13, Psalms 10:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: Joshua sent them out; and they went to set up the ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai on the west side of Ai; but Joshua stayed among the people that night.
